Vizualization for the paper using saved results from the RNAseq analysis. The results that will go to the paper as supplementary tables and figures are saved in the Analysis/Data/RNAseq/2024-01-22_LN folder.

PAM50 subtypes

Predictions were done using the pam50 R package. https://github.com/hoadley-lab/pam50 Parker et al. 2009, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/19204204/ Assign subtypes based on the most highly correlated subtype centroid from pre-existing training data.

Heatmap

Assign per patient subtype. If a patient doesn’t have a baseline samples, use subsequent time points.

TNBCtype subtypes

TNBC samples were classified using the Vanderbilt classifier. https://cbc.app.vumc.org/tnbc/

Assignment using vst values

vstDat_plotting_tnbc.csv was used as an input for the TNBCtype classifier.

The results are in TNBCtype/vst_input_all_samples/
